honesty: What 8 weeks test: survival and mechanics (fills, settlement, gate timing, drawdown behaviour), NOT edge. Weekly P&L sd is about $156 and the archive win rate about 92%, so 8 loss-free weeks happen 51% of the time (0.92^8) whether the true edge is +$20 a week or zero. A pass here means "no loss week yet"; a fail means "one ordinary loss week arrived" (8% a week).

Tail bound, 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on the losing-week rate: this stint 1 losses in 2 traded weeks -> up to 97.5%; expectancy at that rate -$204/wk with losses at the archive's realised size (-$211) and -$1,523/wk at max loss ($1,563). Pooled with the archive (122 weeks, 10 losses -> 124/11): 14.3%; +$10/wk realised, -$129/wk at max loss. Each loss-free week lowers the pooled bound by about 0.1 point; this stint cannot close it.
Capture: 2 closed trades of the 20 needed before the 60% test; mean +$5.0 per traded week against the frozen +$21.6.
Honest expectation at seating (audit 2026-09-20): +$10 to +$22 per traded week, 95% range -$3 to +$40, P(true edge > 0) about 35-40%.
